videos.title: Note Toh Sahi Tha
videos.overview: Karan and Vani's efforts turn out to be futile when a couple, Guna and Nisha, nabs their money. Though helpless, they decide to take vengeance and retrieve all that they've lost.

videos.title: Hawala Bole Toh Trust
videos.overview: Karan and Vani utilise all their existing resources to get an insight into how they lost their money and finally spot their perpetrators.

videos.title: Use Bolte Hai Dimaag
videos.overview: After a frantic search and a series of twists and turns, Karan finally finds traces Guna, the person responsible for his misery.

videos.title: Green Tea
videos.overview: Karan and Vani hatch an elaborate plan to take their revenge from Nisha and Guna, who ruthlessly turned their lives upside down. But will they succeed?

videos.title: The Final Day
videos.overview: After Guna's plan is revealed, Karan plots to trap him. As both the men try to get their hold of the money, this game of hide-and-seek ends with an unexpected twist.
